basic_details.job_title: Zila Panchayat Raigarh Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 11 Accountant, Computer Programmer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Zila Panchayat Raigarh has notified 11 vacancies for Computer Programmer, Programme Officer, Assistant Programmer and Accountant posts on a contract basis. Candidates must apply offline in the prescribed format, sending applications by registered post or speed post to the Chief Executive Officer, Zila Panchayat Raigarh (Chhattisgarh) by 5:30 PM on 10 November 2026. Eligibility criteria and qualifications vary by post, and the notified pay scales range from 5200-20200 with Grade Pay 2400 to 15600-39100 with Grade Pay 5400. The selection process includes merit calculation based on academic perce

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Completed applications in the prescribed format along with self-attested copies of all testimonials and documents must be sent by registered post or speed post to: मुख्य कार्यपालन अधिकारी, जिला पंचायत रायगढ़ (छ.ग.) The envelope containing the application must clearly state the name of the post/cadre applied for ("आवेदन पद का नाम / संवर्ग"). An empty self-addressed envelope with a Rs. 5 postal stamp affixed must be enclosed with the application. Applications submitted through any other medium or received after the prescribed date and time will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Zila Panchayat Raigarh Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notified posts operate under the Vikas Bharat - Rozgar Evam Aajivika Mission (Gramin) across Zila Panchayat Raigarh and the newly formed Sarangarh-Bilaigarh district, focusing on administrative, technical, and accounting duties related to rural development schemes.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested passport-size photograph affixed on the application form. Self-attested copies of mark sheets and certificates for educational qualifications (from 10th/12th onwards to highest qualification). If percentage is not mentioned in mark sheets, grade conversion certificate issued by the institution. Employment exchange registration card with live registration number, date, and validity. Mul Niwas Praman Patra (Domicile Certificate) issued by a competent authority. Sthai Jati Praman Patra (Caste Certificate) issued by a competent authority for reserved categories. Disability certificate issued by a Medical Board (for PwD candidates), if applicable. Experience certificates containing issuing authority name, designation, contact number, email, work period, pay scale, and mention of working in government rural development schemes. No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the current employer, if working in government or semi-government institutions. An empty self-addressed envelope with Rs. 5 postal stamp affixed.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is made through a merit list prepared on the basis of academic percentages, computer practical tests, and experience in government rural development schemes. If applicant numbers exceed 10 times the vacancies, candidates are called for the next stage in a 1:10 ratio based on merit. Selected candidates undergo document verification and skill/practical tests as applicable.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Zila Panchayat Raigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit offline applications is 10 November 2026 by 5:30 PM.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are advertised?
faq.answer: A total of 11 vacancies are notified across Computer Programmer, Programme Officer, Assistant Programmer, and Accountant posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline through registered post or speed post only.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is minimum 21 years and maximum 35 years as on 1 January 2026, with relaxations as per Chhattisgarh government rules for local residents.

faq.question: Q5. Are there any application fees?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any application fee, but candidates must enclose an empty self-addressed envelope with a Rs. 5 postal stamp.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is required for the Accountant post?
faq.answer: Candidates need 55% marks in B.Com (50% for SC, ST, and OBC; second division for Bastar and Surguja division candidates).

faq.question: Q7. Is this recruitment on a regular basis or contract?
faq.answer: Appointments are made strictly on a contract basis initially up to 28 February 2027, subject to extension based on performance and annual appraisals.

faq.question: Q8. Can applicants from outside Chhattisgarh apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must be local residents of Chhattisgarh for posts requiring domicile, and a domicile certificate issued by a competent authority is mandatory.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to the Chief Executive Officer, Zila Panchayat Raigarh (Chhattisgarh) via registered or speed post.
